mapper.select: select mm.id member_id, mm.merchant_id, m.name merchant_name, mm.role, mm.store_scope from merchant_members mm inner join merchants m on m.id = mm.merchant_id and m.status = 'ACTIVE' where mm.user_id = #{userId} and mm.status = 'ACTIVE' order by m.name, mm.id

select mm.id member_id, mm.merchant_id, m.name merchant_name, mm.role, mm.store_scope from merchant_members mm inner join merchants m on m.id = mm.merchant_id and m.status = 'ACTIVE' where mm.user_id = #{userId} and mm.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and mm.status = 'ACTIVE' limit 1

select s.id store_id, s.store_code, s.name store_name from merchant_members mm inner join stores s on s.merchant_id = mm.merchant_id and s.status = 'ACTIVE' where mm.id = #{memberId} and mm.merchant_id = #{merchantId} and mm.status = 'ACTIVE' and (mm.store_scope = 'ALL' or exists ( select 1 from merchant_member_stores mms where mms.member_id = mm.id and mms.store_id = s.id )) order by s.name, s.id
